title: ESP32 Bluetooth Robotic Car
alt: ESP32 Bluetooth-controlled robotic car on a workbench
description: Four-motor rover driven by an L298N motor driver and controlled over Bluetooth SPP from a phone, with custom PWM speed ramping on ESP32 Arduino Core v3.

title: Home Automation
description: An IoT-powered home automation system developed with ESP32 and a 2-channel relay module, demonstrating wireless appliance control, embedded systems programming, and practical automation techniques.

title: RFID-Based Attendance System
description: A smart attendance and access control system built with Arduino Uno and the MFRC522 RFID reader. The system authenticates RFID cards, controls door access using an SG90 servo motor, and provides instant visual and audio feedback through LEDs and a buzzer.

title: Smoke & Flame Detection System
description: A safety-focused embedded system built with Arduino Uno that continuously monitors smoke concentration and flame presence in real time using sensors, LEDs, buzzer and LCD display.

title: STM32 Development Board
description: A custom-designed STM32-based development board created for embedded systems development, prototyping and firmware programming.

title: Dual-Output Regulated Power Supply
description: 7805/7812-based bench supply simulated end-to-end in Proteus, delivering clean 5V and 12V rails with short-circuit protection.

title: Digital Bench Power Supply
description: Constant-voltage / constant-current supply built around an LM338T pass transistor with LM358 and LM741 op-amps for current sensing.

title: Buck Converter
description: Buck converter tuned and corrected for a stable 5V/3A output, verified against ripple and load-transient specifications.

title: LED Chaser
description: A custom-designed LED Chaser Circuit featuring smooth sequential lighting effects, demonstrating digital timing, LED control and practical PCB design.
